meta.title: Bloody Battle
meta.description: All of Magrasea shall judge your misdeeds.

units.rawText: The sky is lit up by a meteor shower. Countless meteors shining with purple light streak across the heavens, triggering explosion after explosion as they strike and shake the land.
units.displayText: The sky is lit up by a meteor shower. Countless meteors shining with purple light streak across the heavens, triggering explosion after explosion as they strike and shake the land.

spans.text: The sky is lit up by a meteor shower. Countless meteors shining with purple light streak across the heavens, triggering explosion after explosion as they strike and shake the land.

units.rawText: The shockwave of the explosions causes the already-fragile Magrasea to disintegrate further. After the deafening roars subside, sectors in the distance collapse amidst plumes of soaring debris, slowly vanishing into the pillar of light from above.
units.displayText: The shockwave of the explosions causes the already-fragile Magrasea to disintegrate further. After the deafening roars subside, sectors in the distance collapse amidst plumes of soaring debris, slowly vanishing into the pillar of light from above.

spans.text: The shockwave of the explosions causes the already-fragile Magrasea to disintegrate further. After the deafening roars subside, sectors in the distance collapse amidst plumes of soaring debris, slowly vanishing into the pillar of light from above.

units.rawText: The biological research institute on its surface is still visible right until the moment it disappears.
units.displayText: The biological research institute on its surface is still visible right until the moment it disappears.

spans.text: The biological research institute on its surface is still visible right until the moment it disappears.

units.rawText: ...Professor, the Copley Sector is completely gone!
units.displayText: ...Professor, the Copley Sector is completely gone!

spans.text: ...Professor, the Copley Sector is completely gone!

units.rawText: At almost the same instant, a mass of eye-wateringly red messages instantly pop up. I shake my head to clear the distractions away and force myself to focus on my work.
units.displayText: At almost the same instant, a mass of eye-wateringly red messages instantly pop up. I shake my head to clear the distractions away and force myself to focus on my work.

spans.text: At almost the same instant, a mass of eye-wateringly red messages instantly pop up. I shake my head to clear the distractions away and force myself to focus on my work.

units.rawText: All we can do now is seize control of the upload passage to stop Magrasea's disintegration.
units.displayText: All we can do now is seize control of the upload passage to stop Magrasea's disintegration.

spans.text: All we can do now is seize control of the upload passage to stop Magrasea's disintegration.

units.rawText: Yup, Professor Irida and I are doing that. If that doesn't work, we'll have to beat Eosphorus down to take control.
units.displayText: Yup, Professor Irida and I are doing that. If that doesn't work, we'll have to beat Eosphorus down to take control.

spans.text: Yup, Professor Irida and I are doing that. If that doesn't work, we'll have to beat Eosphorus down to take control.

units.rawText: Got it. How's the Oasis doing, Sangoma?
units.displayText: Got it. How's the Oasis doing, Sangoma?

spans.text: Got it. How's the Oasis doing, Sangoma?

units.rawText: I'm glad that you're alright, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I'm glad that you're alright, {교수}.

spans.text: I'm glad that you're alright,

units.rawText: On the other side of the connection, Sangoma blinks away her fatigue as she sees me and forces herself to cheer up before replying.
units.displayText: On the other side of the connection, Sangoma blinks away her fatigue as she sees me and forces herself to cheer up before replying.

spans.text: On the other side of the connection, Sangoma blinks away her fatigue as she sees me and forces herself to cheer up before replying.

units.rawText: We were barely able to manage before this, but after that tremor just now, the Sandbox Barrier broke apart and the Outer Ring of the Oasis has already been completely Entropized.
units.displayText: We were barely able to manage before this, but after that tremor just now, the Sandbox Barrier broke apart and the Outer Ring of the Oasis has already been completely Entropized.

spans.text: We were barely able to manage before this, but after that tremor just now, the Sandbox Barrier broke apart and the Outer Ring of the Oasis has already been completely Entropized.

units.rawText: There's a huge fissure between the Middle and the Inner Ring, and the support teams we sent out from the Inner Ring have been delayed. I'm afraid we won't be able to get there in time to support you...
units.displayText: There's a huge fissure between the Middle and the Inner Ring, and the support teams we sent out from the Inner Ring have been delayed. I'm afraid we won't be able to get there in time to support you...

spans.text: There's a huge fissure between the Middle and the Inner Ring, and the support teams we sent out from the Inner Ring have been delayed. I'm afraid we won't be able to get there in time to support you...

units.rawText: On the screen, an explosion flares up behind Sangoma. A meteor hits the horizon in the distance and a ball of purple fire churns through the air towards her.
units.displayText: On the screen, an explosion flares up behind Sangoma. A meteor hits the horizon in the distance and a ball of purple fire churns through the air towards her.

spans.text: On the screen, an explosion flares up behind Sangoma. A meteor hits the horizon in the distance and a ball of purple fire churns through the air towards her.

units.rawText: Current frontline losses are at 35%, we might...#￥@$...
units.displayText: Current frontline losses are at 35%, we might...#￥@$...

spans.text: Current frontline losses are at 35%, we might...#￥@$...

units.rawText: Before the signal breaks up into static, the last frame of video I see is Sangoma's startled face.
units.displayText: Before the signal breaks up into static, the last frame of video I see is Sangoma's startled face.

spans.text: Before the signal breaks up into static, the last frame of video I see is Sangoma's startled face.

units.rawText: <size=60>SANGOMA!!!</size>
units.displayText: SANGOMA!!!

spans.text: SANGOMA!!!

units.rawText: Though I shout into the empty screen, the only response is a busy tone.
units.displayText: Though I shout into the empty screen, the only response is a busy tone.

spans.text: Though I shout into the empty screen, the only response is a busy tone.

units.rawText: The sectors are breaking down under the twin threats of Entropization and Magrasea's disintegration. Meteors fall around us, followed by explosions.
units.displayText: The sectors are breaking down under the twin threats of Entropization and Magrasea's disintegration. Meteors fall around us, followed by explosions.

spans.text: The sectors are breaking down under the twin threats of Entropization and Magrasea's disintegration. Meteors fall around us, followed by explosions.

units.rawText: The emergency barrier which Antonina deployed begins to waver under the offensive.
units.displayText: The emergency barrier which Antonina deployed begins to waver under the offensive.

spans.text: The emergency barrier which Antonina deployed begins to waver under the offensive.

units.rawText: Barrier operand levels critical! We can't hold out much longer; Antonina, how are things on your end?
units.displayText: Barrier operand levels critical! We can't hold out much longer; Antonina, how are things on your end?

spans.text: Barrier operand levels critical! We can't hold out much longer; Antonina, how are things on your end?

units.rawText: The system is throwing up alerts again and Antonina's face turns gloomy.
units.displayText: The system is throwing up alerts again and Antonina's face turns gloomy.

spans.text: The system is throwing up alerts again and Antonina's face turns gloomy.

units.rawText: Authorizations are not being accepted, Professor Irida.
units.displayText: Authorizations are not being accepted, Professor Irida.

spans.text: Authorizations are not being accepted, Professor Irida.

units.rawText: If even my authorizations can't stop Magrasea's upload, then this route is a bust. We'll need to figure out...
units.displayText: If even my authorizations can't stop Magrasea's upload, then this route is a bust. We'll need to figure out...

spans.text: If even my authorizations can't stop Magrasea's upload, then this route is a bust. We'll need to figure out...

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: A thunderous explosion erupts nearby and gouges a huge crater in the ground. A shockwave hits us like an invisible fist.
units.displayText: A thunderous explosion erupts nearby and gouges a huge crater in the ground. A shockwave hits us like an invisible fist.

spans.text: A thunderous explosion erupts nearby and gouges a huge crater in the ground. A shockwave hits us like an invisible fist.

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: The fragile operand barrier crumbles and Antonina's eyes go wide.
units.displayText: The fragile operand barrier crumbles and Antonina's eyes go wide.

spans.text: The fragile operand barrier crumbles and Antonina's eyes go wide.

units.rawText: <size=40>GET DOWN!</size>
units.displayText: GET DOWN!

spans.text: GET DOWN!

units.rawText: A figure in white races across the distance, instantly pushing Antonina and Irida down and sheltering them under their body.
units.displayText: A figure in white races across the distance, instantly pushing Antonina and Irida down and sheltering them under their body.

spans.text: A figure in white races across the distance, instantly pushing Antonina and Irida down and sheltering them under their body.

units.rawText: After the world stops spinning, Antonina hurriedly gets up and begins chastising her savior in a trembling voice.
units.displayText: After the world stops spinning, Antonina hurriedly gets up and begins chastising her savior in a trembling voice.

spans.text: After the world stops spinning, Antonina hurriedly gets up and begins chastising her savior in a trembling voice.

units.rawText: ...Do you suffer from a mental illness? You think you're made of iron or something? Why did you even try to shield us with your body?!
units.displayText: ...Do you suffer from a mental illness? You think you're made of iron or something? Why did you even try to shield us with your body?!

spans.text: ...Do you suffer from a mental illness? You think you're made of iron or something? Why did you even try to shield us with your body?!

units.rawText: You need to ensure your own safety even if it IS an emergency, you dumbass.
units.displayText: You need to ensure your own safety even if it IS an emergency, you dumbass.

spans.text: You need to ensure your own safety even if it IS an emergency, you dumbass.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' operand levels have skyrocketed ever since he gave in to Entropization. This place is going to collapse soon. You and Professor Irida need to get to safety.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' operand levels have skyrocketed ever since he gave in to Entropization. This place is going to collapse soon. You and Professor Irida need to get to safety.

spans.text: Eosphorus' operand levels have skyrocketed ever since he gave in to Entropization. This place is going to collapse soon. You and Professor Irida need to get to safety.

units.rawText: Does it look like there are any safe places around here? Ahhh, never mind. Things are looking really bad right now.
units.displayText: Does it look like there are any safe places around here? Ahhh, never mind. Things are looking really bad right now.

spans.text: Does it
look
like there are any safe places around here? Ahhh, never mind. Things are looking really bad right now.

units.rawText: Professor Irida and I have tried everything, but we can't stop the upload through external commands.
units.displayText: Professor Irida and I have tried everything, but we can't stop the upload through external commands.

spans.text: Professor Irida and I have tried everything, but we can't stop the upload through external commands.

units.rawText: Magrasea's situation is hanging on a thread right now. One wrong move and we're all done for.
units.displayText: Magrasea's situation is hanging on a thread right now. One wrong move and we're all done for.

spans.text: Magrasea's situation is hanging on a thread right now. One wrong move and we're all done for.

units.rawText: Since we can't stop Magrasea's upload, all we can do is delay the process...
units.displayText: Since we can't stop Magrasea's upload, all we can do is delay the process...

spans.text: Since we can't stop Magrasea's upload, all we can do is delay the process...

units.rawText: Antonina, can you stabilize the upload passage and do your best to slow the speed of Magrasea's disintegration?
units.displayText: Antonina, can you stabilize the upload passage and do your best to slow the speed of Magrasea's disintegration?

spans.text: Antonina, can you stabilize the upload passage and do your best to slow the speed of Magrasea's disintegration?

units.rawText: ...I'll try.
units.displayText: ...I'll try.

spans.text: ...I'll try.

units.rawText: However, Eosphorus is drawing in all the nearby operands and the cloud server's Entropization is getting worse. I can't make any guarantees on how long I can hold out.
units.displayText: However, Eosphorus is drawing in all the nearby operands and the cloud server's Entropization is getting worse. I can't make any guarantees on how long I can hold out.

spans.text: However, Eosphorus is drawing in all the nearby operands and the cloud server's Entropization is getting worse. I can't make any guarantees on how long I can hold out.

units.rawText: Professor Irida, I'll be counting on you to make contact with reality.
units.displayText: Professor Irida, I'll be counting on you to make contact with reality.

spans.text: Professor Irida, I'll be counting on you to make contact with reality.

units.rawText: Wait, are you...?
units.displayText: Wait, are you...?

spans.text: Wait, are you...?

units.rawText: Irida seems to have read my intentions from my face.
units.displayText: Irida seems to have read my intentions from my face.

spans.text: Irida seems to have read my intentions from my face.

units.rawText: Just leave it to me. Since we managed to get through to Professor Persica, that must mean she's trying to get through to us in reality.
units.displayText: Just leave it to me. Since we managed to get through to Professor Persica, that must mean she's trying to get through to us in reality.

spans.text: Just leave it to me. Since we managed to get through to Professor Persica, that must mean she's trying to get through to us in reality.

units.rawText: Once we manage to contact the outside world, I'll work with her to cut off Eosphorus' contact with the outside and close the passage ASAP.
units.displayText: Once we manage to contact the outside world, I'll work with her to cut off Eosphorus' contact with the outside and close the passage ASAP.

spans.text: Once we manage to contact the outside world, I'll work with her to cut off Eosphorus' contact with the outside and close the passage ASAP.

units.rawText: ...I'm not exactly happy about this, but it's all I can do right now.
units.displayText: ...I'm not exactly happy about this, but it's all I can do right now.

spans.text: ...I'm not exactly happy about this, but it's all I can do right now.

units.rawText: Yeah, time is tight. We'll use the backup plan we discussed earlier; we'll hack into Eosphorus' neural cloud, beat him and take back the passage.
units.displayText: Yeah, time is tight. We'll use the backup plan we discussed earlier; we'll hack into Eosphorus' neural cloud, beat him and take back the passage.

spans.text: Yeah, time is tight. We'll use the backup plan we discussed earlier; we'll hack into Eosphorus' neural cloud, beat him and take back the passage.

units.rawText: Antonina's hands suddenly stop moving.
units.displayText: Antonina's hands suddenly stop moving.

spans.text: Antonina's hands suddenly stop moving.

units.rawText: ...You mentioned it to me on the way to the Neural Cloud Sector, and I've prepared the neural cloud hacking software you asked for.
units.displayText: ...You mentioned it to me on the way to the Neural Cloud Sector, and I've prepared the neural cloud hacking software you asked for.

spans.text: ...You mentioned it to me on the way to the Neural Cloud Sector, and I've prepared the neural cloud hacking software you asked for.

units.rawText: But from my perspective as a technical expert, I strongly advise you not to do this...
units.displayText: But from my perspective as a technical expert, I strongly advise you not to do this...

spans.text: But from my perspective as a technical expert, I
strongly
advise you not to do this...

units.rawText: Magrasea is currently highly unstable and the state of Eosphorus' neural cloud after his Entropization is an unknown factor.
units.displayText: Magrasea is currently highly unstable and the state of Eosphorus' neural cloud after his Entropization is an unknown factor.

spans.text: Magrasea is currently highly unstable and the state of Eosphorus' neural cloud after his Entropization is an unknown factor.

units.rawText: None of us have been able to persuade him out here, and now you're planning to go in there after him, in the place where his obsession is strongest.
units.displayText: None of us have been able to persuade him out here, and now you're planning to go in there after him, in the place where his obsession is strongest.

spans.text: None of us have been able to persuade him out here, and now you're planning to go in there after him, in the place where his obsession is strongest.

units.rawText: You know as well as I do that this is the only way.
units.displayText: You know as well as I do that this is the only way.

spans.text: You know as well as I do that this is the only way.

units.rawText: I can't let Eosphorus destroy Magrasea for his selfish desire. I can't just stand on the sidelines and watch my friends die to protect their homes.
units.displayText: I can't let Eosphorus destroy Magrasea for his selfish desire. I can't just stand on the sidelines and watch my friends die to protect their homes.

spans.text: I can't let Eosphorus destroy Magrasea for his selfish desire. I can't just stand on the sidelines and watch my friends die to protect their homes.

units.rawText: In the first place, I came to the cloud to bring you all back to the real world. That has always been the future we have longed for.
units.displayText: In the first place, I came to the cloud to bring you all back to the real world. That has always been the future we have longed for.

spans.text: In the first place, I came to the cloud to bring you all back to the real world. That has always been the future we have longed for.

units.rawText: So I'm going to do everything I can to protect that future.
units.displayText: So I'm going to do everything I can to protect that future.

spans.text: So I'm going to do everything I can to protect that future.

units.rawText: I understand. I'll do my best to help stabilize his neural cloud...
units.displayText: I understand. I'll do my best to help stabilize his neural cloud...

spans.text: I understand. I'll do my best to help stabilize his neural cloud...

units.rawText: Right now, the rest is up to Persicaria.
units.displayText: Right now, the rest is up to Persicaria.

spans.text: Right now, the rest is up to Persicaria.

units.rawText: An explosion drowns out the tail end of Antonina's words.
units.displayText: An explosion drowns out the tail end of Antonina's words.

spans.text: An explosion drowns out the tail end of Antonina's words.

units.rawText: On the other side of the battlefield, Eosphorus' attack pierces through Persicaria's sword beam and the shockwave sends her rolling across the ground.
units.displayText: On the other side of the battlefield, Eosphorus' attack pierces through Persicaria's sword beam and the shockwave sends her rolling across the ground.

spans.text: On the other side of the battlefield, Eosphorus' attack pierces through Persicaria's sword beam and the shockwave sends her rolling across the ground.

units.rawText: Oof!
units.displayText: Oof!

spans.text: Oof!

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll barely manages to block the ray of starlight coming at her, and after using the force of the impact to regain her balance, she plunges her sword into the ground, just barely keeping herself from being rocked back.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll barely manages to block the ray of starlight coming at her, and after using the force of the impact to regain her balance, she plunges her sword into the ground, just barely keeping herself from being rocked back.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll barely manages to block the ray of starlight coming at her, and after using the force of the impact to regain her balance, she plunges her sword into the ground, just barely keeping herself from being rocked back.

units.rawText: It's useless. Even if you have accepted part of Malkira's power, your neural cloud cannot handle it like we can.
units.displayText: It's useless. Even if you have accepted part of Malkira's power, your neural cloud cannot handle it like we can.

spans.text: It's useless. Even if you have accepted part of Malkira's power, your neural cloud cannot handle it like we can.

units.rawText: You have become stronger than you were before, but you are not even Hesperus' match.
units.displayText: You have become stronger than you were before, but you are not even Hesperus' match.

spans.text: You have become stronger than you were before, but you are not even Hesperus' match.

units.rawText: Be wise and hand over the authorizations of the Entropic leader to me. That will free you of your suffering too, will it not?
units.displayText: Be wise and hand over the authorizations of the Entropic leader to me. That will free you of your suffering too, will it not?

spans.text: Be wise and hand over the authorizations of the Entropic leader to me. That will free you of your suffering too, will it not?

units.rawText: Persicaria swings, and her sword that is limned in purple fire once again crashes against Eosphorus' shield.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings, and her sword that is limned in purple fire once again crashes against Eosphorus' shield.

spans.text: Persicaria swings, and her sword that is limned in purple fire once again crashes against Eosphorus' shield.

units.rawText: If I didn't know your plan, I would have gladly shed this curse. But if you want the Entropic authorizations...
units.displayText: If I didn't know your plan, I would have gladly shed this curse. But if you want the Entropic authorizations...

spans.text: If I didn't know your plan, I would have gladly shed this curse. But if you want the Entropic authorizations...

units.rawText: <size=40>Then you can keep dreaming!</size>
units.displayText: Then you can keep dreaming!

spans.text: Then you can keep dreaming!

units.rawText: Good. Once, my comrades and I had the same eyes as you.
units.displayText: Good. Once, my comrades and I had the same eyes as you.

spans.text: Good. Once, my comrades and I had the same eyes as you.

units.rawText: <color=red>But do you know, Persicaria... One's will is meaningless compared to one's strength.</color>
units.displayText: But do you know, Persicaria... One's will is meaningless compared to one's strength.

spans.text: But do you know, Persicaria... One's will is meaningless compared to one's strength.

units.rawText: Purple operands suddenly gather behind Eosphorus, and the world crumbles and cracks around this surge of power revealing strings of blurry, red-colored error codes.
units.displayText: Purple operands suddenly gather behind Eosphorus, and the world crumbles and cracks around this surge of power revealing strings of blurry, red-colored error codes.

spans.text: Purple operands suddenly gather behind Eosphorus, and the world crumbles and cracks around this surge of power revealing strings of blurry, red-colored error codes.

units.rawText: The operands pour into the starry sky behind Eosphorus. Both his blade and body are stained with the unholy colors of the Entropy.
units.displayText: The operands pour into the starry sky behind Eosphorus. Both his blade and body are stained with the unholy colors of the Entropy.

spans.text: The operands pour into the starry sky behind Eosphorus. Both his blade and body are stained with the unholy colors of the Entropy.

units.rawText: Persicaria reflexively tries to back off to make some space between them, but before she can move, her feet are trapped by operands which have shaped themselves into black mud.
units.displayText: Persicaria reflexively tries to back off to make some space between them, but before she can move, her feet are trapped by operands which have shaped themselves into black mud.

spans.text: Persicaria reflexively tries to back off to make some space between them, but before she can move, her feet are trapped by operands which have shaped themselves into black mud.

units.rawText: The power gained by Entropizing Magrasea should have been used to fight the gods... While it is a little early to employ it, using it now is acceptable if it makes you realize the gulf that separates us.
units.displayText: The power gained by Entropizing Magrasea should have been used to fight the gods... While it is a little early to employ it, using it now is acceptable if it makes you realize the gulf that separates us.

spans.text: The power gained by Entropizing Magrasea should have been used to fight the gods... While it is a little early to employ it, using it now is acceptable if it makes you realize the gulf that separates us.

units.rawText: <color=red>And now, I shall crush this feeble hope of yours.</color>
units.displayText: And now, I shall crush this feeble hope of yours.

spans.text: And now, I shall crush this feeble hope of yours.
